article.title: Audit of accounts of Panchayats
article.content: The Legislature of a State may, by law, make provisions with respect to the maintenance of accounts by the Panchayats and the auditing of such accounts.
article.html:
243JAudit of accounts of Panchayats

Article 243J · Part IX

The Legislature of a State may, by law, make provisions with respect to the maintenance of accounts by the Panchayats and the auditing of such accounts.
